source: insurtechny.com/competition/ live page, pulled 2026-09-22, cross-confirmed against 50 Wayback captures 2020-07-24 to 2025-07-23
description: InsurTech NY's 'Global Early-Stage InsurTech Startup Competition' - annual pitch competition at the Spring Conference. $200K prize pool split Carrier/Broker Prize ($100K) and Investor Prize ($100K). Eligibility: <$250K recurring revenue, sells to/serves insurers, brokers, or risk management orgs.
coverage: full 2020-2026 (7 years) for winners; finalist lists present for most years but not guaranteed complete for every category/year

2024.note: Further AI = FurtherAI, already in the 309-company dataset; category winners not distinguished on the current page for this year

bermuda_note: 2020 had a dedicated 'Bermuda BDA Winner' category (Remitrix) - confirms InsurTech NY partners with the Bermuda Business Development Agency on this competition (per PR Newswire release, 'InsurTech NY and the Bermuda Business Development Agency Join Forces for Early-Stage InsurTech Competition'). This is the extent of Bermuda-specific census data found - no independent Bermuda insurtech org with its own multi-year cohort list was found (see sister_orgs_multiyear.json).
